recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20758 unless a work group opens a new issue for guidance beyond the published resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-20758 was a Published FHIR-core Provenance change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that relevantHistory use of Provenance be explained on the Provenance page, with the approved note saying Event or Request pattern relevantHistory elements point to a relevant subset of Provenance and should link to Event and Request history guidance.
initial_application: No issue-keyed source commit was found for FHIR-20758. Commit 19da5709adf007d9a932f4145dc95406396a7bc0 appears to have applied it by adding the Relevant History Provenance section to source/provenance/provenance-notes.xml, after FHIR-20760 commit ade95b75ec661dbb73690a3be5a63a363d89ad6f added the Request and Event history sections.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists provenance as an active resource, and current provenance-notes.xml still contains the requested section. The originating Zulip thread explains that relevantHistory is a curated subset of Provenance, not all Provenance, and the 2020-01-13 Security minutes state that FHIR-20758 was waiting on FHIR-20760.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current source already satisfies the resolved request; adding more local prose would duplicate the maintained Request/Event guidance rather than fixing a semantic problem.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-20760 supplied the Request/Event relevantHistory guidance that FHIR-20758 points to and was explicitly identified as the prerequisite in Security minutes.
